title: 上海高考翻译背诵-78-SSP高考专刊

items.zh: 为什么不把料理家务作为自己的习惯呢?
items.en: Why not make a habit of doing housework?

items.zh: 教授介绍了风险管理的基本概念,这是金融学的基础。
items.en: The professor introduced the basic concepts of risk management, which underlie finance.

items.zh: 过去的10年来,生物学家对濒临灭绝的海洋物种表示同情。
items.en: Over the past decade, biologists have been sympathetic to marine species threatened with extinction.

items.zh: 中国和欧洲宇航员将合作执行太空任务的协议为科学技术的突破性进步铺平了道路。
items.en: The agreement that Chinese and European astronauts will cooperate on space missions paves the way for breakthroughs in science and technology.
